title: Prolific 2025-11-19
text:
SetupReading




Code
library(tidyverse)






Code
dat_full <- qualtRics::read_survey(here::here("..", "Data", "prolific_2025.11.19.csv")) |>
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         .keep = "unused")









Code
dat <- dat_full |>
  select(id, matches("^[F][GL][PV]_[0-9\\.-]+$")) |>
  pivot_longer(!id,
               names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
  filter(!is.na(response)) |>
  separate_wider_regex(item, c(cond = "[F][GL][PV]", "_", rest = ".*")) |>
  separate_wider_regex(rest, c(fixed = "^\\d*", "-*", rest = ".*")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(rest, "-", names = c("varied"), too_few = "align_end") |>
  separate_wider_position(cond, c(1, "frame" = 1, "target" = 1)) |>
  mutate(.by = c(frame, target, fixed),
         item = cur_group_id(),
         .after = id) |>
  mutate(.by = c(item, id),
         trial = 1:n(),
         .after = id) |>
  mutate(varied = as.numeric(varied),
         fixed = as.numeric(fixed),
         lottery = ifelse(target == "P", varied, fixed),
         certain = ifelse(target == "V", varied, fixed),
         
         lottery_std = (lottery - mean(lottery)) / sd(lottery),
         certain_std = (certain - mean(certain)) / sd(lottery),
         
         # if matches the fixed dollar option, 0, else 1 (for risky)
         chose_risky = ifelse(str_detect(response, "Keep \\$[0-9]+") | 
                                str_detect(response, "Forfeit \\$[0-9]+"), 0, 1)) |>
  left_join(dat_full |>
              select(id, starts_with("IUS") & !matches("IUS_T")) |>
              pivot_longer(!id, names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
              mutate(response = case_when(response == "Entirely characteristic of me" ~ 5,
                                          response == "Very characteristic of me" ~ 4,
                                          response == "Somewhat characteristic of me" ~ 3,
                                          response == "A little characteristic of me" ~ 2,
                                          response == "Not at all characteristic of me" ~ 1)) |>
              summarize(.by = id,
                        IUS = mean(response)),
            by = "id") |>
  mutate(ev_varied = ifelse(frame == "L", 100 - varied, varied),
         ev_fixed = ifelse(frame == "L", 100 - fixed, fixed),
         lottery_certain_diff = lottery_std - certain_std,
         across(c(IUS, lottery_certain_diff), ~ (.x - mean(.x)) / sd(.x),
                .names = "{.col}_z"))

m0 <- lme4::glmer(chose_risky ~ 1 + (1 | item) + (1 | id),
            dat, family = "binomial")

text:
SetupReadingFile Structure




Code
library(tidyverse)






Code
dat_full <- qualtRics::read_survey(here::here("..", "Data", "prolific_2026.01.14.csv")) |>
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         .keep = "unused") |>
  filter(Progress == 100)






Code
if (!file.exists(here::here("Models"))) dir.create(here::here("Models"))









Code
dat <- dat_full |>
  select(id, matches("^[F][GL][PV]_[0-9\\.-]+$")) |>
  pivot_longer(!id,
               names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
  filter(!is.na(response)) |>
  separate_wider_regex(item, c(cond = "[F][GL][PV]", "_", rest = ".*")) |>
  separate_wider_regex(rest, c(fixed = "^\\d*", "-*", rest = ".*")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(rest, "-", names = c("varied"), too_few = "align_end") |>
  separate_wider_position(cond, c(1, "frame" = 1, "target" = 1)) |>
  mutate(.by = c(frame, target, fixed),
         item = cur_group_id(),
         .after = id) |>
  mutate(.by = c(item, id),
         trial = 1:n(),
         .after = id) |>
  mutate(varied = as.numeric(varied),
         fixed = as.numeric(fixed),
         lottery = ifelse(target == "P", varied, fixed),
         certain = ifelse(target == "V", varied, fixed),
         
         lottery_std = (lottery - mean(lottery)) / sd(lottery),
         certain_std = (certain - mean(certain)) / sd(lottery),
         
         # if matches the fixed dollar option, 0, else 1 (for risky)
         chose_risky = ifelse(str_detect(response, "Keep \\$[0-9]+") | 
                                str_detect(response, "Forfeit \\$[0-9]+"), 0, 1)) |>
  left_join(dat_full |>
              select(id, starts_with("IUS") & !matches("IUS_T")) |>
              pivot_longer(!id, names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
              mutate(response = case_when(response == "Entirely characteristic of me" ~ 5,
                                          response == "Very characteristic of me" ~ 4,
                                          response == "Somewhat characteristic of me" ~ 3,
                                          response == "A little characteristic of me" ~ 2,
                                          response == "Not at all characteristic of me" ~ 1)) |>
              summarize(.by = id,
                        IUS = mean(response)),
            by = "id") |>
    left_join(dat_full |>
              select(id, starts_with("BIS/BAS") & !matches("BISBAS_T")) |>
              pivot_longer(!id, names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
              mutate(response = case_when(response == "Very true for me" ~ 4,
                                          response == "Somewhat true for me" ~ 3,
                                          response == "Somewhat false for me" ~ 2,
                                          response == "Very false for me" ~ 1)) |>
              summarize(.by = id,
                        BIS_BAS = mean(response)),
            by = "id") |>
      left_join(dat_full |>
              select(id, starts_with("STAI-T") & !matches("STAI-T_T")) |>
              pivot_longer(!id, names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
                # double check these codings
              mutate(response = case_when(response == "Almost never" ~ 4,
                                          response == "Often" ~ 3,
                                          response == "Sometimes" ~ 2,
                                          response == "Almost always" ~ 1)) |>
              summarize(.by = id,
                        STAI_T = mean(response)),
            by = "id") |>
  mutate(ev_varied = ifelse(frame == "L", 100 - varied, varied),
         ev_fixed = ifelse(frame == "L", 100 - fixed, fixed),
         lottery_certain_diff = lottery_std - certain_std,
         across(c(IUS, BIS_BAS, STAI_T), ~ (.x - mean(.x)) / sd(.x),
                .names = "{.col}_z"))







Code
m0 <- lme4::glmer(chose_risky ~ 1 + (1 | item) + (1 | id),
            dat, family = "binomial")
saveRDS(m0, here::here("Models", "risky-choice_0.rds"))

m1.0 <- lme4::glmer(chose_risky ~ IUS_z + BIS_BAS_z + STAI_T_z + lottery_certain_diff + frame + 
                      (1 | item) + (1 | id), 
                  dat, family = "binomial",
                  lme4::glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
saveRDS(m1.0, here::here("Models", "risky-choice_1.0.rds"))

m1.1 <- lme4::glmer(chose_risky ~ IUS_z + BIS_BAS_z + STAI_T_z + lottery_certain_diff + frame +

                      IUS_z:lottery_certain_diff + BIS_BAS_z:lottery_certain_diff + STAI_T_z:lottery_certain_diff +
                    (1 | item) + (1 | id), 
                  dat, family = "binomial",
                  lme4::glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
saveRDS(m1.1, here::here("Models", "risky-choice_1.1.rds"))

Code
dat <- dat_full |>
  select(id, matches("^[F][GL][PV]_[0-9\\.-]+$")) |>
  pivot_longer(!id,
               names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
  filter(!is.na(response)) |>
  separate_wider_regex(item, c(cond = "[F][GL][PV]", "_", rest = ".*")) |>
  separate_wider_regex(rest, c(fixed = "^\\d*", "-*", rest = ".*")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(rest, "-", names = c("varied"), too_few = "align_end") |>
  separate_wider_position(cond, c(1, "frame" = 1, "target" = 1)) |>
  mutate(.by = c(frame, target, fixed),
         item = cur_group_id(),
         .after = id) |>
  mutate(.by = c(item, id),
         trial = 1:n(),
         .after = id) |>
  mutate(varied = as.numeric(varied),
         fixed = as.numeric(fixed),
         lottery = ifelse(target == "P", varied, fixed),
         certain = ifelse(target == "V", varied, fixed),
         
         lottery_std = (lottery - mean(lottery)) / sd(lottery),
         certain_std = (certain - mean(certain)) / sd(lottery),
         
         # if matches the fixed dollar option, 0, else 1 (for risky)
         chose_risky = ifelse(str_detect(response, "Keep \\$[0-9]+") | 
                                str_detect(response, "Forfeit \\$[0-9]+"), 0, 1)) |>
  left_join(dat_full |>
              select(id, starts_with("IUS") & !matches("IUS_T")) |>
              pivot_longer(!id, names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
              mutate(response = case_when(response == "Entirely characteristic of me" ~ 5,
                                          response == "Very characteristic of me" ~ 4,
                                          response == "Somewhat characteristic of me" ~ 3,
                                          response == "A little characteristic of me" ~ 2,
                                          response == "Not at all characteristic of me" ~ 1)) |>
              summarize(.by = id,
                        IUS = mean(response)),
            by = "id") |>
    left_join(dat_full |>
              select(id, starts_with("BIS/BAS") & !matches("BISBAS_T")) |>
              pivot_longer(!id, names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
              mutate(response = case_when(response == "Very true for me" ~ 4,
                                          response == "Somewhat true for me" ~ 3,
                                          response == "Somewhat false for me" ~ 2,
                                          response == "Very false for me" ~ 1)) |>
              summarize(.by = id,
                        BIS_BAS = mean(response)),
            by = "id") |>
      left_join(dat_full |>
              select(id, starts_with("STAI-T") & !matches("STAI-T_T")) |>
              pivot_longer(!id, names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
                # double check these codings
              mutate(response = case_when(response == "Almost never" ~ 4,
                                          response == "Often" ~ 3,
                                          response == "Sometimes" ~ 2,
                                          response == "Almost always" ~ 1)) |>
              summarize(.by = id,
                        STAI_T = mean(response)),
            by = "id") |>
  mutate(ev_varied = ifelse(frame == "L", 100 - varied, varied),
         ev_fixed = ifelse(frame == "L", 100 - fixed, fixed),
         lottery_certain_diff = lottery_std - certain_std,
         across(c(IUS, BIS_BAS, STAI_T), ~ (.x - mean(.x)) / sd(.x),
                .names = "{.col}_z"))

title: Mark’s Old Data
text:
SetupReading




Code
library(tidyverse)






Code
dat_mess <- qualtRics::read_survey(here::here("..", "Data", "old-data.csv")) |>
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         .keep = "unused")







Cleaning the old data.


Code
# note FGV 85 corresponds to 95 and 52 to 50. checked in survey.

# dat |> select(starts_with("FGV5-5"), starts_with("FLV5")) |> View() # to see that the larger number ones are the FLV ones
# dat |> select(starts_with("FGV50-38"), starts_with("FLV50")) |> View() # to see that the larger number ones are the FLV ones

dat <- dat_mess |>
  select(id, matches("^[F][GL][PV][0-9\\.-]+$"),
         # named these two wrong
         matches("^FPG75[0-9-]+$"), 
         matches("^FVG75[0-9-]+$")) |>
  # flipping second and third characters bc named wrong
  rename_with(.cols = matches("^FPG75[0-9-]+$") | matches("^FVG75[0-9-]+$"),
              ~ paste0(substr(.x, 1, 1),
                       substr(.x, 3, 3),
                       substr(.x, 2, 2),
                       substr(.x, 4, nchar(.x)))) |>
  # more that were named wrong
  # hardcoding name change, see above for justification code
  rename(`FGV5-5` = `FGV5-5...332`,
         `FLV5-5` = `FGV5-5...691`,
         `FGV50-38` = `FGV50-38...183`,
         `FLV50-38` = `FGV50-38...530`) |>
  pivot_longer(!id,
               names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
  filter(!is.na(response)) |>
  separate_wider_regex(item, c(cond = "[F][GL][PV]", rest = ".*")) |>
  separate_wider_regex(rest, c(fixed = "^\\d*", "-*", rest = ".*")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(rest, "-", names = c("trace", "varied"), too_few = "align_end") |>
  mutate(varied = ifelse(varied == "", fixed, varied),
         fixed = case_when(fixed == "85" ~ "95",
                           fixed == "52" ~ "50",
                           fixed == "5" ~ "05",
                           .default = fixed)) |>
  separate_wider_position(cond, c(1, "frame" = 1, "target" = 1)) |>
  mutate(.by = c(frame, target, fixed),
         item = cur_group_id(),
         .after = id) |>
  mutate(.by = c(item, id),
         trial = 1:n(),
         .after = id) |>
  # only two types of responses within a combo of item, trial, and varied
  mutate(.by = c(item, varied),
         optct = length(unique(response)),
         optmin = min(response),
         optmax = max(response)) |>
  mutate(choice = case_when(
    optct > 1 & response == optmin ~ 0,
    optct > 1 & response == optmax ~ 1,
    optct == 1 & response == 1 ~ 0,
    optct == 1 & response == optmax ~ 1) |>
      factor(0:1, labels = c("fixed", "risky")),
    varied = as.numeric(varied),
    fixed = as.numeric(fixed),
    lottery = ifelse(target == "P", varied, fixed),
    certain = ifelse(target == "V", varied, fixed),
    lottery_std = (lottery - mean(lottery)) / sd(lottery),
    certain_std = (certain - mean(certain)) / sd(lottery),
    risky = ifelse(choice == "risky", 1, 0)) |>
  left_join(dat_mess |>
              select(id, starts_with("IUS") & !matches("IUSt")) |>
              pivot_longer(!id, names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
              summarize(.by = id,
                        IUS = mean(response)),
            by = "id") |>
  mutate(ev_varied = ifelse(frame == "L", 100 - varied, varied),
         ev_fixed = ifelse(frame == "L", 100 - fixed, fixed),
         chose_risky = ifelse(choice == "risky", 1, 0),
         lottery_certain_diff = lottery_std - certain_std,
         across(IUS, ~ (.x - mean(.x, na.rm = T)) / sd(.x, na.rm = T),
                .names = "{.col}_z")) 

# filter(dat, .by = c(item, id), max(trial) == 1) # 18 instances (6 people) of only one trial


Calculating Subjective Certainty Equivalence (SCE) and Subjective Probability Equivalence (SCP) values for each person and item. If the participant selected the choice of the varying factor, the SxE should be less appealing than the last trial by half the distance between the varying factor value in the final two rounds. If the participant selected the choice of the fixed factor, the the SxE should be more appealing than the last trial by half the distance between the varying factor value in the final two rounds.


Code
SxE <- dat |>
  filter(.by = c(id, item),
         trial == max(trial) | trial == max(trial) - 1) |> 
  summarize(.by = c(id, item),
            frame = first(frame),
            target = first(target),
            fixed = first(ev_fixed),
            SxE = case_when(target == "P" & last(choice) == "risky" ~ last(ev_varied) - abs(last(ev_varied) - first(ev_varied)) / 2,
                            target == "P" & last(choice) == "fixed" ~ last(ev_varied) + abs(last(ev_varied) - first(ev_varied)) / 2,
                            target == "V" & last(choice) == "risky" ~ last(ev_varied) + abs(last(ev_varied) - first(ev_varied)) / 2,
                            target == "V" & last(choice) == "fixed" ~ last(ev_varied) - abs(last(ev_varied) - first(ev_varied)) / 2),
            ev_fixed = first(ev_fixed))


Here are the trends of the expected value of the fixed factor and the subjective equivalent of the varying factor.

Code
SPE <- SxE |>
  filter(target == "P") |>
  lme4::lmer(SxE ~ ev_fixed + frame + (1 | id) + (1 | item), data = _)

SPE |>
  ggeffects::ggpredict(terms = c("ev_fixed", "frame")) |>
  plot() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(),
                     breaks = c(5, 25, 50, 75, 95)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
                     breaks = c(5, 25, 50, 75, 95)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(y = "SPE", title = "Subjective Probability Equivalence", x = "EV Certain") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray80", linewidth = 2))
SCE <- SxE |>
  filter(target == "V") |>
  lme4::lmer(SxE ~ ev_fixed + frame + (1 | id) + (1 | item), data = _)

SCE |>
  ggeffects::ggpredict(terms = c("ev_fixed", "frame")) |>
  plot() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(),
                     breaks = c(5, 25, 50, 75, 95), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
                     breaks = c(5, 25, 50, 75, 95), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "SCE", title = "Subjective Certainity Equivalence", y = "EV Probability")  +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray80", linewidth = 2))

title: Mark’s Old Data
text:
SetupReading




Code
library(tidyverse)






Code
dat_mess <- qualtRics::read_survey(here::here("..", "Data", "old-data.csv")) |>
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         .keep = "unused")







Cleaning the old data.


Code
# note FGV 85 corresponds to 95 and 52 to 50. checked in survey.

# dat |> select(starts_with("FGV5-5"), starts_with("FLV5")) |> View() # to see that the larger number ones are the FLV ones
# dat |> select(starts_with("FGV50-38"), starts_with("FLV50")) |> View() # to see that the larger number ones are the FLV ones

dat <- dat_mess |>
  select(id, matches("^[F][GL][PV][0-9\\.-]+$"),
         # named these two wrong
         matches("^FPG75[0-9-]+$"), 
         matches("^FVG75[0-9-]+$")) |>
  # flipping second and third characters bc named wrong
  rename_with(.cols = matches("^FPG75[0-9-]+$") | matches("^FVG75[0-9-]+$"),
              ~ paste0(substr(.x, 1, 1),
                       substr(.x, 3, 3),
                       substr(.x, 2, 2),
                       substr(.x, 4, nchar(.x)))) |>
  # more that were named wrong
  # hardcoding name change, see above for justification code
  rename(`FGV5-5` = `FGV5-5...332`,
         `FLV5-5` = `FGV5-5...691`,
         `FGV50-38` = `FGV50-38...183`,
         `FLV50-38` = `FGV50-38...530`) |>
  pivot_longer(!id,
               names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
  filter(!is.na(response)) |>
  separate_wider_regex(item, c(cond = "[F][GL][PV]", rest = ".*")) |>
  separate_wider_regex(rest, c(fixed = "^\\d*", "-*", rest = ".*")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(rest, "-", names = c("trace", "varied"), too_few = "align_end") |>
  mutate(varied = ifelse(varied == "", fixed, varied),
         fixed = case_when(fixed == "85" ~ "95",
                           fixed == "52" ~ "50",
                           fixed == "5" ~ "05",
                           .default = fixed)) |>
  separate_wider_position(cond, c(1, "frame" = 1, "target" = 1)) |>
  mutate(.by = c(frame, target, fixed),
         item = cur_group_id(),
         .after = id) |>
  mutate(.by = c(item, id),
         trial = 1:n(),
         .after = id) |>
  # only two types of responses within a combo of item, trial, and varied
  mutate(.by = c(item, varied),
         optct = length(unique(response)),
         optmin = min(response),
         optmax = max(response)) |>
  mutate(choice = case_when(
    optct > 1 & response == optmin ~ 0,
    optct > 1 & response == optmax ~ 1,
    optct == 1 & response == 1 ~ 0,
    optct == 1 & response == optmax ~ 1) |>
      factor(0:1, labels = c("fixed", "risky")),
    varied = as.numeric(varied),
    fixed = as.numeric(fixed),
    lottery = ifelse(target == "P", varied, fixed),
    certain = ifelse(target == "V", varied, fixed),
    lottery_std = (lottery - mean(lottery)) / sd(lottery),
    certain_std = (certain - mean(certain)) / sd(lottery),
    risky = ifelse(choice == "risky", 1, 0)) |>
  left_join(dat_mess |>
              select(id, starts_with("IUS") & !matches("IUSt")) |>
              pivot_longer(!id, names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
              summarize(.by = id,
                        IUS = mean(response)),
            by = "id") |>
  mutate(ev_varied = ifelse(frame == "L", 100 - varied, varied),
         ev_fixed = ifelse(frame == "L", 100 - fixed, fixed),
         chose_risky = ifelse(choice == "risky", 1, 0),
         lottery_certain_diff = lottery_std - certain_std,
         across(IUS, ~ (.x - mean(.x, na.rm = T)) / sd(.x, na.rm = T),
                .names = "{.col}_z")) 

# filter(dat, .by = c(item, id), max(trial) == 1) # 18 instances (6 people) of only one trial


Calculating Subjective Certainty Equivalence (SCE) and Subjective Probability Equivalence (SCP) values for each person and item. If the participant selected the choice of the varying factor, the SxE should be less appealing than the last trial by half the distance between the varying factor value in the final two rounds. If the participant selected the choice of the fixed factor, the the SxE should be more appealing than the last trial by half the distance between the varying factor value in the final two rounds.


Code
SxE <- dat |>
  filter(.by = c(id, item),
         trial == max(trial) | trial == max(trial) - 1) |> 
  summarize(.by = c(id, item),
            frame = first(frame),
            target = first(target),
            fixed = first(ev_fixed),
            SxE = case_when(target == "P" & last(choice) == "risky" ~ last(ev_varied) - abs(last(ev_varied) - first(ev_varied)) / 2,
                            target == "P" & last(choice) == "fixed" ~ last(ev_varied) + abs(last(ev_varied) - first(ev_varied)) / 2,
                            target == "V" & last(choice) == "risky" ~ last(ev_varied) + abs(last(ev_varied) - first(ev_varied)) / 2,
                            target == "V" & last(choice) == "fixed" ~ last(ev_varied) - abs(last(ev_varied) - first(ev_varied)) / 2),
            ev_fixed = first(ev_fixed))


Here are the trends of the expected value of the fixed factor and the subjective equivalent of the varying factor.

Code
SPE <- SxE |>
  filter(target == "P") |>
  lme4::lmer(SxE ~ ev_fixed + frame + (1 | id) + (1 | item), data = _)

SPE |>
  ggeffects::ggpredict(terms = c("ev_fixed", "frame")) |>
  plot() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(),
                     breaks = c(5, 25, 50, 75, 95)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
                     breaks = c(5, 25, 50, 75, 95)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(y = "SPE", title = "Subjective Probability Equivalence", x = "EV Certain") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray80", linewidth = 2))
SCE <- SxE |>
  filter(target == "V") |>
  lme4::lmer(SxE ~ ev_fixed + frame + (1 | id) + (1 | item), data = _)

SCE |>
  ggeffects::ggpredict(terms = c("ev_fixed", "frame")) |>
  plot() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(),
                     breaks = c(5, 25, 50, 75, 95), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
                     breaks = c(5, 25, 50, 75, 95), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "SCE", title = "Subjective Certainity Equivalence", y = "EV Probability")  +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray80", linewidth = 2))













Code
m0 <- lme4::glmer(chose_risky ~ 1 + (1 | item) + (1 | id),
            dat, family = "binomial")

m1.0 <- lme4::glmer(chose_risky ~ IUS_z + lottery_certain_diff + frame + 
                      (1 | item) + (1 | id), 
                  dat, family = "binomial")

m1.1 <- lme4::glmer(chose_risky ~ IUS_z + lottery_certain_diff + frame + 
                      IUS_z:frame + IUS_z:lottery_certain_diff + frame:lottery_certain_diff +
                    (1 | item) + (1 | id), 
                  dat, family = "binomial")
